title: Cloud Atlas (20th Anniversary Edition): A Novel
author: David Mitchell and Gabrielle Zevin

highlights.text: Peace, though beloved of our Lord, is a cardinal virtue only if your neighbors share your conscience.
As many truths as men. Occasionally, I glimpse a truer Truth, hiding in imperfect simulacrums of itself, but as I approach, it bestirs itself & moves deeper into the thorny swamp of dissent.
